metadata.description: Claude Code distribution of the Infiquetra portable Agent Plugins catalog. Each entry installs a portable package together with its Claude client extension; the packages themselves stay vendor-neutral.

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: A spoken conversational loop for one explicitly bound, Herdr-managed Claude Code session: the bound session speaks its completed response, the operator answers by voice, and the transcript lands editable and unsubmitted in that same session's input box.
